Create Criteria table

create_criteria_table.Rd

Displays the criteria and associated levels used in the discrete choice experiment. Saves the pivot table as extdata/tables/table_criteria.html.

Usage

create_criteria_table()

Value

gt table of the criteria (Table 1)

Examples

baitlist::create_criteria_table()
